Context: Instructions for Pension Disbursing Authorities.-

- (ii) On death of a pensioner, the spouse is not required to submit Form 14 (now Form 10 of CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021), if he/she was having a joint account with the pensioner and authorization for payment of family pension exists in the Pension Payment Order (PPO) in his/her favour. In such cases, spouse will be required to provide only a copy of the death certificate to the pension paying branch in order to commence his/her family pension.
